name: tandem
description: Two independent observers for every stream check: the citizen answers first, the AI looks at the photos blind, and the citizen decides. OneAquaHealth IEEE Global Hackathon 2026, Track 3.

scripts.fhir:validate: java -jar tools/validator_cli.jar fhir/examples/*.json fhir/terminology/*.json -version 4.0.1 -ig tools/oah/fsh-generated/resources -ig fhir/terminology -ig hl7.fhir.uv.xver-r5.r4#0.1.0 -tx https://tx.fhir.org/r4
scripts.fhir:ig: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/hl7-eu/oah tools/oah && npx -y fsh-sushi tools/oah
